name: file_indexing
description: Indexes files, symbols, dependencies, and routes into a persisted knowledge graph. Incremental: only files whose hash changed are re-parsed (Law 8, Law 14).

inputs.name: project_root
inputs.description: Absolute path to the project root.

inputs.name: changed_files
inputs.description: Paths to re-index; omit for full re-index.

side_effects: Persists updated graph to memory module

error_codes.message: A file could not be parsed by any registered language pack.
Memory module refused to persist the graph.
